parties: Srei Venture Capital Trust (Infrastructure Project Development Fund) acquiring shares in Bharat Road Network Limited
headline: Srei Venture Capital Trust Files Substantial Acquisition Disclosure for BRNL under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Srei Venture Capital Trust's Infrastructure Project Development Fund has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of or increase in shareholding in Bharat Road Network Limited. The disclosure triggers SEBI Takeover Regulations reporting requirements.
implication: Substantial acquisition disclosures under Regulation 31(4) flag when an acquirer crosses defined shareholding thresholds; this filing creates a public record and potential regulatory gates (public offer obligations, SC approval, shareholder consent depending on final holding % and deal structure).
detail: Srei Venture Capital Trust, acting through its Infrastructure Project Development Fund, has made a substantial acquisition of shares in BRNL and filed the mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the NSE. The filing indicates crossing of one or more threshold limits under the Takeover Code. No acquisition value, final shareholding percentage, or deal structure details are disclosed in the available source.
